name: Mont-Rouge
summary: Welcome to Mont-Rouge, a splendid isolated coastal town in New Brunswick. As we celebrate the end of the tourist season, the savage and inexplicable murder of a man involved in the community disrupts this charming, uneventful village.

name: Rahti
summary: Rahti is a domestic drama series about international human smuggling and a group of people who have to deal with it. A young Eritrean woman loses her husband and her daughter while fleeing to Finland, a pair of brothers who have run into financial difficulties steal a van with people hidden inside, and a lawyer who has been waiting for adoption for years becomes the guardian of a child whose parents' whereabouts are unknown.

name: My Trans Life
summary: Filmed over the course of two years, My Trans Life offers an intimate portrait of the lives of five young transgender people on their journey to transition. If you are affected by any of the issues raised in this show, you can visit rte.ie/support for helpline information

name: Six Schizophrenic Brothers
summary: America's "most mentally ill family" reveals the terrifying true story of how schizophrenia ripped through their family, affecting six of 12 siblings.

name: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country
summary:
Charlie Cooper's Myth Country will follow him as he tours the UK in his campervan, investigating everything from Crop Circles and UFOs in Wiltshire to roaming ghost dogs on the coast and countryside of East Anglia. Charlie will meet the believers and the naysayers, visiting iconic locations and gathering evidence in a bid to get to the bottom of the truth.

In an era of social media misinformation and online echo chambers, where can we go to separate the news from the nonsense? The happenings from the hoaxes? The facts from the fiction? This series will see Charlie search spooky small-town goings on, uncovering eye-witness accounts and elusive evidence as well as staging his own experiments in a bid to bring him closer to the truth. Along the way, he will pay homage to the countryside legends of brilliant Britain and will explore how they have come to define the places and people they originate from.

name: My Dream Green Home
summary: Our Green Team help everyday Kiwis transform their homes and lives to become more sustainable, sharing tips and tricks we can all use for a better future.

name: Make Mate 1
summary: Make Mate 1 is a program that contains the meaning of "Time to become one with MAKE friends (MATE) to create the stage you dreamed of," and it is a program that depicts the process of 36 multinational participants running toward their dream of becoming an idol. It is not a survival program involving trainees belonging to an entertainment agency but a survival program performed by ordinary boys who do not have an agency. The final debut group will debut as Makestar's new boy group.

name: Double Cheat: Itsuwari no Keikan
summary: Keisuke Takara was a detective who chased after a major scammer. Now, he works as a police officer at a police box located along a shopping street. He appears like an ordinary police officer who is friendly with the people in the neighborhood, but Keisuke Takara has a hidden side. He is also Scammer K who targets bad people that are able to avoid the law.

name: Commander Karan Saxena
summary: As ISI-aided terror looms over the nation, RAW agent Karan Saxena must race against the clock to avert the attacks. But conspirators lurk in every shadow!

name: Perfect Wife: The Mysterious Disappearance of Sherri Papini
summary: Keith and Sherri Papini's seemingly idyllic family life is shattered when Sherri vanishes from their northern California neighborhood, triggering a frenzied search that becomes news around the world.

name: Pirates: Behind the Legends
summary: Charting the voyages and exploits of infamous pirate legends, with the help of historical experts and a wealth of pirate artifacts.

name: The Exchange
summary: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the most important stories to today's markets and investors.

name: Me
summary: Me follows a 12-year-old kid named Ben who is in the throes of middle school (complete with bullies, crushes and school dances!) as he adjusts to a newly blended family AND the realization that he has super powers.

name: The Rainmaker
summary: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head-to-head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend. Rudy, along with his boss and her disheveled paralegal, uncover two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

name: Jezabel
summary:
Set in Israel, Jezabel tells the story of a Phoenician princess who uses her beauty and seduction power to achieve all she wants. She marries King Ahab to become queen, but she suffers strong opposition from the Israelite people in attempting to impose on everyone the worship of the pagan gods Baal and Asherah.

Stubborn and unwavering in her convictions, Jezabel is a woman capable of anything to achieve her goals and destroy her enemies.

She has Elijah as the greatest adversary, a powerful prophet whose sole mission is to spread the word of the One God and to defend the Israelis.

name: Deutschland von oben
summary: Documentary series that presents the country exclusively from a bird's eye view for the first time. The photographs were taken over a whole year using helicopters, ultralight aircraft and motor aircraft - from the Alps and the low mountain ranges to the heath landscapes and the Wadden Sea.

name: Pedaço de Mim
summary: Due to a rare phenomenon, a woman finds herself pregnant with twins by two men. Over time, she strives to keep her family united — and her secrets hidden.

name: Pulang Araw
summary: Pulang Araw is a family drama that tells stories of courage, sacrifice, and hardships that every Filipino family has. These stories were inspired by the tales of the unsung heroes who defied the odds of World War II and the Japanese occupation of the Philippines.

name: Tokyo Swindlers
summary: Can a group of real estate scammers pull off a 10-billion-yen scam without getting caught? This is the intriguing premise of Tokyo Swindlers, a masterful crime thriller about realty fraudsters driven by greed.

name: Greatest Prison Escapes with Billy Hayes
summary:
Billy Hayes' legendary escape from a Turkish prison was the basis for the Oscar-winning movie Midnight Express. Now, with his unique first hand experience Billy takes us into the world of the Greatest Prison Escapes! Through reenactments, we'll experience audacious jail and prison breaks in dramatic form.

We'll hear intriguing interviews with the survivors, witnesses, historians, and law enforcement of each event. We'll meet the prisoners. Experience the private hells. The risks, rewards, and failures. One by one, with each dangerous and thrilling step, host Billy Hayes will present to the audience a vivid tour of the Greatest Prison Escapes!

name: Mayberry Man: The Series
summary: Small town Americana and modern life collide when movie star Chris Stone falls in love with Mayberry's sweetheart. Meanwhile, Mayberry's quirky citizens confront a nefarious plot to wipe their antiquated town off the map.

name: Heavenly Brick Hero
summary: The aloof and proud architectural genius Li Ji was kidnapped by a creature from another world, the Dark Qilin, and taken to a secret realm called the Soul Mind Space. In this secret realm lies the ruins of an ancient heavenly court. The Dark Qilin told him that if he wants to return, he must pass the trial set by the Heavenly Dao, which is to rebuild the heavenly court...

name: The Institute
summary: When 12-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won't last, as his story and Luke's are destined to collide.

name: Closing Bell: Overtime
summary: A look at after-hours moves, including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading.

name: Mystery Migration: Red Crabs of Christmas Island
Perfect Family
summary: A story of the family of Choi Sun Hee, who seems to be happy and perfect to anyone, going through the death of her friend Gyeong Ho one day.

name: Video Nasty
summary: Teen best friends, Billy and Con are in the final year of school and are going on one last hurrah when things are complicated by the unwelcome addition of Con's older sister Zoe. Seemingly simple friendships become complicated and complex family dynamics are made to withstand unprecedented pressures. The three teenagers go on an epic quest to complete a cult VHS collection, only to get mixed up in a gruesome murder investigation, becoming chief suspects and public enemies.

name: Ni shi wo de Jie Yao
The Secret Life of Bees
summary:
The series follows British naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall showing us what it takes to be a beekeeper when he becomes an apiarist for the first time, as well as exploring the importance of the 270 different bee species in Britain, showcasing the marvels of their societies; examining the importance of their existence through history; and delving into the science and cutting edge research being conducted into these fascinating creatures.   

Without bees and other pollinators our food security would be seriously compromised – they are vital to the well-being of the UK and the planet.

name: Brian and Maggie
summary:
1989. When two old friends, the 'much feared inquisitor', Brian Walden, and 'Iron Lady' Prime Minister, Margaret Thatcher, come together for their last ever TV interview, little do they realise they're about to embark on one of the most infamous political exchanges of all time. The 45-minute showdown became a national talking point and set in train a series of events that ended with Margaret's resignation.

Afterwards, they never spoke again…

name: Строптивая мишень
summary:
Of course, Dina had had troubles before. But she would have lived comfortably in her small provincial town if it weren't for the secret hobbies and criminal inclinations of her husband Oleg, nicknamed Student. Because of him, Dina got into real trouble.
Fleeing from who knows where the mysterious pursuers and the bandit Eddie fell upon her, Dina met a reliable friend and true love. Now she knows how to move on with her life.
Dizzying chases, scary and funny bandits, involuntary lies and deliberate deception, suspicions, distrust of those who are nearby - all this remains in the past, in a small town, with which, having experienced many bitter moments, the heroes who have become inseparable, Dina and Alexey, her savior and chosen one.

name: Алмазы на десерт
summary:
It's all about the diamonds. Their underground cutting is established in a provincial town. The criminal business is controlled by the owner of the local restaurant Pavel Sergeevich - Pavlik. Together with him is his former school friend, police chief Valery Petrovich - Valera. Pavlik is also trying to involve another former classmate, engineer Yuri Vladimirovich - Yu. V. in his business.
The fate of Yu.V. did not work out. He went to prison on false charges. Upon his release, Yuri Vladimirovich happily accepts Pavlik's offer to work in his hometown. But the position of chief engineer turns out to be just bait in the diamond scam.
Yu. V. faces difficult trials and dizzying adventures. All the more dramatic because a woman is involved. This is Rita, the wife of the policeman Valera, whom Yu. V. loves. The intrigue twists even stronger when Yu. V.'s only daughter unexpectedly appears in the city - a student at the capital's university, Masha, whom her father has not seen for many years.
Mysterious disappearances, chases, shootouts, blackmail... In extreme circumstances, those who think more about others than themselves will win.

name: Дом без выхода
summary: Architects Tina and Stas Kirillov acquire a cozy country house. The family is doing well - both in personal aspect and at work. Tina's friend since their student years Maryana has always been in love with Stas and tries not to lose sight of the couple. Maryana is married to Alexei, but her heart still belongs to the former fellow student. Gradually, envy of the personal and professional success of Tina and Stas gets stronger and stronger, and now the ill-wisher is ready to step over a lot in order to steal the husband from her ""sworn"" girlfriend.

name: Индус
summary: Anton Ponomaryov (Marat Basharov) devotes all his time and efforts to developing a conceptually new implant with the ability to speed up bone healing and help even in hopeless cases. However, scientific community does not appreciate Anton's piece of work which causes Vedernikov (Alexander Samoilenko), head of Scientific Research Institute, to put Ponomarev's laboratory under threat of being shut down. Fortunately, the situation is being resolved thanks to Anton's old friend Leonid Lazarev (Egor Beroev), a successful businessman, who possesses broad connections in political and business circles. Childhood friends establish a joint venture to finish the implant development and perform its market launch. Leonid finds an Indian investor who is ready to support the venture. But the invention is to be tested earlier than planned. Anton's tutor's granddaughter suffers a terrible spinal cord injury. In order to save her Ponomarev at his own risk inserts the implant that has not been certified yet. The surgery goes well. Anton places a similar implant into his own arm in order to experience the same as his patient and be able to help her. Being full of hopes Anton flies to India to conduct negotiations but the plane crashes. Anton found miraculously alive but disfigured is taken to a local hospital where he is found out to suffer full memory loss. Sergei recognizes his friend but decides to conceal it in order to get his hands on the entire implant manufacturing business. Having protection of an influential Indian friend Sergei starts to perform implant surgeries. Many of them result in patients' deaths... and only Anton who bears a clue to the puzzle in his arm can explain why... Anton's way to happiness will be long and winding. Undergoing a plastic surgery, regaining memory and realizing who he is are in store for him. He will have to make a hard choice between his family left in Moscow who believes he is dead and his new Indian love, Maya. But the most complicated challenge he is to solve is to stop a succession of medical errors which he could partly be blamed for.

name: Спецкор отдела расследований
summary: Dmitry is a young journalist. Near him always is a girl Nadya who's in love with Dmitry for many years.

name: In the Eye of the Storm
summary: In the Eye of the Storm Megastorms like 2021's Hurricane Ida and the 2023 Maui Wildfires were captured by onlookers who found themselves in the wrong place at the right time and boldly held up their camera phones to document their experiences.

name: Oh My God…Yes!
summary: Oh My God… Yes! follows three friends navigating womanhood in an unpredictable, tech-driven world.

previousepisode.name: or i'll give you something to cry about

name: Haha, You Clowns
summary: Haha You Clowns follows three sweet natured brothers who, alongside their deeply caring father, embark on various adventures as they bond together in the wake of their mother's passing.

name: Get Jiro
summary: Get Jiro is set in a not-too-distant future L.A. where master chefs rule the town and people literally kill for a seat at the best restaurants. A mysterious sushi master named Jiro enters a bloody culinary war and begins to craft his recipe for revenge.

name: Super Mutant Magic Academy
summary: Super Mutant Magic Academy is set at a high school where the student body is a mix of mutants and "regular" kids. Through eyes of Marsha, a sardonic new transfer student with a mysterious past, the series follows the awkward high school struggles and occasional triumphs of a diverse cast of teens as they stumble through romance, friendships and growing mutant powers.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Syndicated five-day-a-week revival of the durable game show, where couples chosen from the audience attempted to complete stunts within a time limit.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Classic game show where couples (and sometimes families) competed to win prizes by completing stunts within a time limit.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Unlike previous versions, this version had kids playing the game along with adults.

name: Trooping the Colour
summary: Join Andrew Pearce and Ellie Costello, with Cameron Walker at Buckingham Palace for full coverage of the parade to mark the King's official birthday.

name: The Einstein Challenge
summary: The world is complicated, and sometimes we need things explained to us like we're kids. Today's greatest minds will do just that! In each episode of The Einstein Challenge, two world-class experts in science, history and engineering will see who can best explain complicated concepts to kids.

name: Anupama: Namaste America
summary: Seventeen years ago, Anupama gets an opportunity of a lifetime to live her dreams. Now she has to make a tough choice between her career and her family.

name: I Parry Everything
summary: The Kingdom of Clays faces a dire crisis: an assassination attempt has just been made on its own Princess Lynneburg, and its neighboring countries eye the aftermath like starving vultures, plotting the Kingdom's downfall. The ensuing conflict will shape the face of the continent for centuries to come…but Noor doesn't have a clue about any of that! Having freshly arrived at the royal capital after over a decade of rigorous, isolated training at his mountain home, he's dead set on achieving his childhood dream of becoming an adventurer, even if the only skills he possesses are useless ones. Sure, he can [Parry] thousands of swords in the span of a single breath, but everybody knows you need more than that if you want to be an adventurer! Our hero's road to making his dream come true will be long(?) and arduous(?)—but if there's one thing Noor's not afraid of, it's some good ol' fashioned hard work!

name: The Proof Is Out There: Alien Edition
summary: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, journalist Tony Harris will present compelling evidence of UFO sightings from around the globe. Are these videos proof that aliens exist? Tony and a team of experts will analyze the evidence and render a verdict.

name: Giji Harem
summary: Eiji Kitahama joins the drama club with dreams of having a harem like the ones from his favorite manga. Rin Nanakura, an underclassman, finds herself crushing hard on Eiji, and tries on different personas in his presence to win him over. No matter how she acts, one thing is certain—her feelings for Eiji continue to grow stronger. Will she ever be able to tell him the truth and be herself?

name: Tasuuketsu
summary:
The WEB Comic "Tasuketsu" by Miyakawa Taiga serialized in manga app "GANMA!" is finally becoming an anime! 

The game began suddenly. It was "Tasuketsu," a brutal survival game in which the majority is eliminated. In order to fight back against the immensely powerful emperor masterminding the game, young men and women create their own futures using the mysterious special ability known as "Special Right."

name: Super Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
summary:
Dogs – they love us, protect us, and would do anything for us.

But some clever canines are taking that dedication to extremes, doing everything from sniffing out crimes to saving lives and helping humans heal from PTSD. Welcome to the world of Super Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs!

Over two episodes, we meet a range of incredible hero hounds, seeing them in action as they use their training and talents to make the world a better place for humans and other animals. And we explore the ground-breaking techniques that have turned these super pups from loving pets into something even more special.

name: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
summary: Tom Kerridge hits the road in his 1950s food truck to discover wonderful produce, cooking with the ingredients he finds along the way.

name: Chock
summary: Chock is a Swedish horror TV series from 1997. Each episode was presented by the Swedish cult actor and horror host, Ernst-Hugo Järegård. Episodes were directed by Mikael Håfström, Daniel Bergman and Ulf Malmros among others.

name: The Loyal Pin
summary: Her Serene Highness Aninlaphat, or Princess Anil, and Mom Rajawongse Pilanthita, or Khunying Pin, have been close since they were young. When Princess Anil is fifteen, she must travel to England for her studies, separating the princess from her close friend Khunying Pin by a great distance. The distance, however, allows Anil to come to know herself, to know deep down how she's felt about Khunying Pin without question. Once she returns to Thailand, Princess Anil tries everything to get near to Khunying Pin where she can find the opportunity to confess her love. However, it seems to be an impossible task as Khunying Pin has been engaged to marry Khun Chai Kueakiat.

name: Accidental Farmer & Co.
summary: Inheriting a debt-ridden farming estate is hardly a dream come true, especially for a man with no direction in life. Just about having given up on the barren land, the man stumbles upon a mysterious medicinal herb. He decides to cultivate it so he can pay off the debt but ends up attracting wanted as well as some unwanted attention.

name: Salt City
summary: The show explores the journey of the Bajpai family through the complexities of the lives of each crisscrossing the other while exposing the past, coming to grips with the present, and unfolding a promising future.

name: Moving In with Malaika
summary: All set to showcase her true self, Malaika will shut down trolls in her quintessential Arora style as she opens up about her life.

previousepisode.name: What's Next for Malaika and Amrita?

name: Red Swan
summary: Oh Wan Soo, a former world-class golfer married into the powerful Hwain Group, finds herself targeted by death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do Yoon, a bodyguard investigation a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

name: Черный список. На кухне
summary: Ilya Zakharov and Alexander Rambo Pushkov will check the aptitude of chefs all over Russia to get them into the best restaurants in the country. Unscrupulous chefs will be permanently blacklisted, and for providing high-quality services, the masters will receive double wages and, possibly, a dream job.

name: Место силы
summary: A bold experiment from the TNT channel, in which magicians, mediums, parapsychologists, psychics and other people with extraordinary abilities will try to prove that magic exists. 13 heroes of the project will gather in the most mystical city of Russia - St. Petersburg, to unravel the famous mysteries of the past, touch centuries-old legends and help celebrities who find themselves in paranormal and mystical situations. Our team of superheroes, using their unusual talents, will work together to unravel the most unexpected and mysterious stories. And all in order to, together with the viewer, test reality for strength and separate fantasies from incredible reality, expose some myths and confirm others. During the project, the heroes live together, and this will help both the viewer and the participants to immerse themselves as deeply as possible into the otherworldly world, not only in completing tasks, but also in unpacking themselves. At the end of the project, the winner will receive a cash prize.

name: A Chan
summary: Connected by a mysterious antique pocket watch, Zhang Jing Chan and Li Wei Yi are suddenly transported back in time, where they discover their souls have been swapped. Forced to live each other's lives, they become determined to protect their families and rewrite the painful fates that bind them. As the two navigate tangled timelines, hidden truths, and growing emotional burdens, they realize that changing destiny may be far more complicated—and dangerous—than they ever imagined

name: Jing Hong Yi Xiao Re Tian Jiao
Summit of Our Youth
summary: Summit of Our Youth is a youth fantasy drama packed with inspiration and feel-good moments. It follows Gu Xuejiao, a love-obsessed office worker, who unexpectedly travels back to her high school days after getting laid off. Determined to fix past regrets, she shifts her focus from romance to ambition. With the help of the brilliant top student Lin Zhihua, she reinvents her life. And they fall into a sweet, mutual love as they grow together.

name: Born with Luck
summary: Zhang Yi'ang, a police officer who has been away from frontline criminal investigation for years, is dispatched to Sanjiangkou after receiving an anonymous tip from the provincial department. Shortly after arrival, he witnesses the murder of his criminal investigation captain. While clearing himself of suspicion, he unexpectedly arrests a serial killer, quickly gaining prestige. As he focuses his investigation on the gang of Zhou Rong, a wealthy local businessman, the numerous bumbling thieves and their infighting create a butterfly effect that ironically help him and his team. Supposed fate brings him together with all the thieves, and he ultimately prevails, uncovering the motive behind his colleague's murder and bringing the real culprit to justice.

name: The Secret Path
summary: Yang Guang, Deputy Director of the Third Division of National Security, is caught up in a conspiracy involving an international spy organization during a mission. As a series of unexpected incidents unfold, Yang Guang and his team realize they are facing a crisis that threatens the leakage of national secrets. Sensing an earth-shattering conspiracy lurking behind these events, Yang Guang leads his division to investigate. Amid the escalating crisis, a woman named Zhao Yani becomes the focal point of the investigation. Her identity and actions are shrouded in mystery. At times, she appears to obstruct the uncovering of the truth, making her a prime suspect; at other times, she seems to secretly push events forward, leaving everyone guessing about her true intentions. Faced with carefully laid traps by the enemy, Yang Guang refuses to retreat. Instead, he bravely infiltrates the heart of danger. As the situation intensifies, Yang Guang and Zhao Yani, seemingly from opposing camps, are drawn into a complex vortex where the lines between friend and foe blur. Meanwhile, the real enemy hides in the shadows, waiting to strike. Through trials and relentless battles, Yang Guang remains steadfast in his mission. Thanks to a series of daring moves and sharp decisions, he successfully uncovers and thwarts the enemy's conspiracy, preventing the theft of vital national secrets. Only at the story's end does Yang Guang finally uncover Zhao Yani's unique and mysterious identity, and their long conversation becomes a secret between them. Behind the triumph lies profound personal sacrifice and intense moral struggles. Though the immediate threat has been neutralized, Yang Guang and his team know that in a world full of shifting dangers, new threats are always lurking just around the corner.

name: Dead End
summary: Two generations of policemen stumbled forward with unwavering determination, searching for the murderer in the maze-like alleys and finally breaking out of the dead ends in their lives.

name: Соло для пистолета с оркестром
summary: Lonely widow Yulia Shumova accidentally sees an American film on TV, the plot of which completely repeats the life story of her late husband Peter and his companion and childhood friend Mikhail Gvozditsky. It follows from the film that the car accident in which Peter died was set up by an unknown avenger in black. In a panic, she rushes to the police, where Gena Mylnikov, recently appointed to a leadership position, does not take her words seriously. But in vain...

name: Эра стрельца
summary: In the center of the plot is a triple murder. A successful businessman Alexander Serebryakov and two pensioners, the Zavyalov family, were shot dead in an elevator. The operatives are not happy with another cold case and are not going to deal with the motives...

name: Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin
summary: Spoiled harvest goddess Sakuna finds herself banished from her opulent celestial home to an island overrun with demons. In the untamed wilderness, she must rediscover her birthright as the daughter of a warrior god and harvest goddess by weathering the elements, fighting monsters, and cultivating rice, the source of her power. By her side in this forbidding place is her guardian Tama and a group of outcast humans. Together, these unlikely companions must join hands to tame both the soil and the demons of Hinoe Island.

name: Mayonaka Punch
summary: Meet Masaki, the now former member of the popular NewTuber group, Harikiri Sisters. After a career setback, aka getting fired unexpectedly via a live stream, she joins forces with Live, a partner with superhuman abilities. Together, they aim to create sensational content and reach 1 million subscribers. Will they reach their content dreams or be hit with the block button?

name: Opri Paraai
summary: After a boy was killed by someone, the spirit of the boy possessed a married girl. In his desire for revenge, the boy seeks to punish his killer.

name: The Bahatis Empire
summary: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

name: The Elusive Samurai
summary: In the year 1333, the Kamakura shogunate government comes crumbling down. A trusted vassal, Ashikaga Takauji, betrays the shogunate and organizes a rebellion. Hojo Tokiyuki, the rightful heir, escapes the massacre with a Shinto priest named Suwa Yorishige to Kamakura. On the run and fighting to stay alive, Tokiyuki sets in motion his plan to reclaim his birthright.

name: Shoushimin Series
summary: Kobato, who once had a bitter experience through deduction activities known as "wisdom work," was determined to become an honest and humble citizen. He secretly formed a reciprocal relationship with his classmate, Osanai, who shared the same aspiration, planning to make their high school debut as ordinary citizens and lead peaceful days. However, for some reason, mysterious incidents and misfortunes keep coming one after another into their school lives. Will Kobato and Osanai be able to achieve peaceful days as ordinary citizens?

name: Gimai Seikatsu
summary: An unlikely love story begins when Yuuta's dad remarries, and his new stepsister is the cutest girl in school.

name: Elf-san wa Yaserarenai
summary: Naoe-kun, a massage therapist, is about to head home for the day when he's saddled with a rather strange patient. This lovely lady has emerald eyes, pointy ears, and grew up in the forest—everything about her screams "elf," except for one thing: her bodacious body. It turns out she left her world but loves junk food in this one, and now her obsession has caught up with her. Can Naoe-kun help this loveable elf girl lose the weight—and keep it off?

previousepisode.name: The Beefy Soldier and Remnants of a Dream

name: Sky News at 3pm
summary: A summary of the latest news headlines.

name: Milkshake! Craft Party
summary: Showing how to make a range of fun artistic creations from common household items.

name: Rumors
summary: A young woman recounts the devastating experience of relationships destroyed, reputations tainted, and a career halted- all due to rumors spread by a "friend".

name: MBTI Love
summary: It is adapted from "Mr. Huo Dotes on Me". It tells the story of the piano teacher Wen Man, and the lawyer Huo Shaoting. They are not good at expressing love. From the test to doubt, and they can finally trust each other.

name: Apocalypse: Les débarquements
summary: June 6, 1944. A titanic fleet launches an attack on the beaches of Normandy. Objective: to free Europe from Hitler's yoke. The mission was a spectacular success: the Allies of the Second World War managed to overcome their political differences, overcome logistical difficulties and carry out an operation with unprecedented military challenges. How, before and after D-Day, did authorities, soldiers and civilians experience this turning point in History?

name: First Note of Love
summary: Neil is a singer-songwriter who has recently returned to Taiwan. Both talented and charming, he has everything he needs to become a professional singer, except one thing––the nerves to step onto a big stage. In an effort to get over his stage fright, Neil decides to start as a street performer to eventually work his way up. Hai is a loyal but timid fan of Neil's. One late night, after seeing Neil's performance, Hai gets on the last bus of the day and is surprised to see Neil get on, too. The bus brakes suddenly, and Hai finds himself in Neil's arms. When Neil gets off the bus, Hai sees his guitar pick on the floor. And so, Hai and Neil's lives cross paths as they begin to compose a musical movement of love…

name: Sugar Dog Life
summary: Sakuraba is a college student, though you'd never know it, with his short height and baby face. Certainly, police officer Amazawa thought Sakuraba was a minor, and nearly booked him for being out too late after he was returning from a drinking party. But there's something oddly familiar about him, and the two strike up an odd relationship…

name: Profe Infiltrado
summary: The "sports teacher" Julián seeks to obtain as much evidence as possible to arrest the father of a student, who is a criminal. However, the story will take an important turn when Julián falls in love with Miss Sofia.

name: Sai Sueb Sai Sadeu
summary: Chachai Fuangfoo and Chachai Phudeung are police officers w/ similar names. As they chase down drug traffickers, they find other similarities that lead them to hilarious adventures together.

name: Prajun San Gon
summary: Yodkwan and Tak just got married and got the free honeymoon tour package to Kraiwan Island. However, they couldn't go, so Yodkwan gave that ticket to her sister, Pluemjai who was going to work on that island and Tak gave that ticket to his brother, Tiw who was going to see his girlfriend on that island. Pluemjai and Tiw had to travel together as a couple in the honeymoon tour group, though they hate each other. They thought they would separate from this tour group to do their own business when they reached there. However, there was some reason that made them unable to separate and had to stay together as a couple.

name: The Magical Girl and the Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
summary: The story centers on Mira, the clever brains behind an evil organization that invades and destroys everything in its path. One day, a magical girl named Byakuya Mimori decides to stand up to the organization, and Mira falls in love with her at first sight.

name: Catch 21
summary: Catch 21 hosted by Alfonso Ribeiro and Witney Carson. You might recognize the duo from Dancing with the Stars. Catch 21 is a Vegas style Game Show where three contestants are each given a card to start a blackjack hand from a standard 52-card deck and must answer trivia questions. Can they catch three blackjack 21s?

name: Last Call
summary: Fresh takes on business topics that explore the intersection of money, culture, and policy.

name: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
summary: Meet the girls on the losing side of romance! First is Anna Yanami, the girl-next-door type who can't say no to delicious food. Then there's Lemon Yakishio, a beautiful and spirited athlete. Last but not least is Chika Komari, the cute yet shy heroine with gentle charm. Together, they navigate awkward setbacks hoping to finally find love!

previousepisode.name: Am I Actually Just Some Unseasoned Rando Who Drops In for the Last Episode with the Losing Heroine?

name: Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai
summary: Jun Shirosaki's love life takes a wild turn when he finds himself caught between the Jinguji twins—his childhood friends who are as different as night and day. Rumi, the older sister, pairs a boyish charm with a maiden's heart, while Naori combines girlish looks with her deep love for otaku culture. As feelings grow and confusion mounts, Jun must navigate this unexpected love triangle next door.

name: Delico's Nursery
summary: Hailing from a prestigious noble house, Dali Delico is an elite member of the Blood Pact Council, the highest governing body of the Vamps. Yet, Dali flatly refuses a mission the Vamps assign him. As Dali's motives and possible connection to mysterious murders begin to mount, council members Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique visit him in hopes he'll reconsider, but find him soothing an infant child!

name: VTuber Nandaga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
summary: Yuki Tanaka is a VTuber at Live-On, one of Japan's largest VTuber companies, as the polite and ladylike Awayuki Kokorone. One day, she forgets to end the stream, and viewers see her real personality—irreverent, improper, and prone to imbibing after a long day. Yuki is surprised to find that her accident caused her rankings to multiply, so she doubles down and gets to work. She'll be a star yet!

name: Take Me Out Feet First
summary: Take Me Out Feet First is a documentary series profiling 25 extraordinary terminally ill people, in unimaginable circumstances, who have take control of how they will die.

name: Unidade Básica
summary: Inspired by real cases, the series takes place in a Basic Health Unit, and brings stories of overcoming and challenges faced by two physicians who have different views on the performance in the UBS.

name: Mr & Mrs Chinnathirai
summary: Your favourite celebrity couples put their relationship to test through a series of fun, challenging and hilarious tasks! Whom will you root for this season?...

name: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
summary: From a Glasgow call centre, 16-year-old Elliot Castro began scamming innocent people. But the luxury lifestyle it funded spiralled into darkness, danger - and eventually prison.

name: Scandinavia with Simon Reeve
summary: A new travelogue will see Simon journey to Scandinavia, travelling from the Arctic to the Baltic to uncover the secrets of this beautiful and extreme region. Nordic societies are known for their wealth and happiness, but the Russian invasion of Ukraine and the impact of mass immigration have put them under new pressure. As well as showcasing some of the most spectacular scenery on earth, Scandinavia with Simon Reeve will reveal a hidden side to what has become one of the most important frontiers of Europe.

name: Outrageous Homes
summary: From the unusual and unconventional to the eccentric and eclectic, Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen visits some of the UK's most outrageous homes and celebrates their proud-to-be-different owners and designers

name: The Nightbeast
summary: A young mother unsatisfied with her seemingly perfect suburban life begins an affair with the boogeyman in her son's closet — a surprisingly sexy man called the Nightbeast. But this harmless affair she thought to be a figment of her imagination begins to have unexpected consequences, as her two worlds increasingly begin to collide in this seductive, darkly comedic tale.

name: New Zealand's Best Homes with Phil Spencer
summary: Join property expert Phil Spencer (Location, Location, Location) as he takes viewers on a tour of some of Aotearoa's most stunning homes and gives a glimpse into the lifestyles they have to offer.

name: Happy Jävla Pride
summary: Dilan comes from a small Swedish town and goes up to Stockholm to experience his first Pride Week. He moves in with his cousin Ari. When Ari's best friend Nina becomes homeless, she also moves in with her cousins. The trio gets to experience a fast-paced week together.

name: Mina og meg med hele sirkuset
summary: Mina, Lilje and Alexander go on another expedition, and this time mum Kristin and Rose (9 months) join them. The trip starts from Maridalen to Finnmark.

name: Wonderoos
summary: Join animal pals Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly and Teshi as they learn how to make friends, try new foods and face other big firsts in colorful Roo City!

name: Le siècle des icônes
summary: The Century of Icons recounts, in three episodes, the 20th century through its greatest icons. From Charlie Chaplin to Charles de Gaulle, from Marlene Dietrich to Lady Diana, via Gandhi, JFK or even Nelson Mandela, director Bertrand Delais has selected characters who have left their mark on the most incredible century in the history of humanity, that of emancipation and individual freedom.

name: The Mystery House
summary: Bai Xiao Jun suddenly loses contact with his fiancée. His last clue is a building in the shape of a dilapidated tube, where the woman was last seen. Wanting to find her, Xiao Jun takes the risk and decides to move there. On his journey, he meets a woman named Suo La, who decides to help him with his mission. But after entering the building, they both discover that this place hides many secrets, that its inhabitants have a lot to hide, and that they are not happy at all with the appearance of the two snooping intruders. But what are they really hiding, and how does it connect to missing women?

name: My lovely wife, don't mess with me
Qing Qi Tai You Ren, Jin Yu Shou Fu Liao Feng Le
Ni Shi Wo De Xiao Huanxi
Re La Guntang Zhi Huali Bian Shen
La pasión turca
summary:
Olivia, a Spanish Fine Arts professor with a brilliant professional career, wakes up from a coma in an Istanbul hospital after having attempted suicide. There she answers the questions of an inspector who investigates Olivia's collaboration in an art smuggling network with Yaman, her Turkish lover.

The protagonist's story reconstructs in two stages the overwhelming passion that she experienced with Yaman and that made him abandon her life project in Spain. A story full of lights and shadows about which Olivia does not always tell the truth, which fuels the mystery that surrounds her stay in Turkey and her participation in the man's dangerous businesses.

To escape from jail and gain protection from the authorities, Olivia must return to Yaman and inform the police of her movements. An act as brave as it is desperate: is Olivia acting to save herself or to save Yamam and her love story?

name: Le siècle des lumières
summary: From the 18th century onwards, many thinkers, scientists and philosophers, questioned the dogmas of the Church, the arrangement of nature and even absolute monarchy. The work on universal gravitation by Isaac Newton, or Diderot's Encyclopedia for example, have largely contributed to this evolution of thought. In doing so, they spread the spirit of the Enlightenment and laid the foundations of democracy and the modern State.

name: Blade's Dance with You
summary: Assassin Zhao Xiaoren from the Flash Sect was assigned to assassinate Junmo of Jasmine Manor. Disguising herself as a bride, she married Junmo, both concealing secrets. Through daily deceit, they developed feelings, only discovering Junmo was the exiled seventh prince. This revelation embroiled them in a murky struggle for succession, where love blossomed amid deadly confrontations. Together, they united to quell conspiracies.

name: Sea of No Return
summary: An imperial princess and a border prince, born on opposing sides of a century-old feud, enter a marriage of schemes and grudges that spirals into a doomed yet unforgettable love.

name: Ashes to Crown
summary: The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous currents of the court, leads troops into battle, and ultimately rewrites her own destiny, sparing the people of the State of Chu from the ravages of war.

name: Òlòtūré: The Journey
summary: Working undercover as a sex worker in Nigeria, a young journalist out to expose corruption fights for her life as she forges a path to Europe.

name: What a Wonderful World
summary: This is a healing journey of self-reconciliation. In the world of adults, the monotony of everyday life silently erodes the soul, between breaking down and recovering, wounds are stitched up and torn open repeatedly. Loneliness drifts through the bustling city, caught in the endless cycle of day and night, swallowed by a dense forest of steel and concrete, where neither light nor a sky of one's own can be found. Two souls, reflected in a rearview mirror, gradually shed their disguises and defenses, finding redemption and embracing each other in love. Reality and illusion intertwine, suspense and mystery weave together, and emotions and salvation coexist. Ultimately, the self is the way home. Looking at the world once more, one is no longer alone.

name: Issues and Answers
summary: Issues and Answers was a weekly TV news program that was telecast by the American Broadcasting Company network from November 1960 to November 1981. The series was distributed to the ABC affiliate stations on Sunday afternoons for either live broadcast or video taped for later broadcast.

name: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
summary: David Westin speaks with influential personalities in finance about the week's biggest issues on Wall Street.

name: Love's Ambition
summary: Xu Yan, a popular broadcaster, and Shen Haoming, an urban elite, are an enviable couple. Yet, due to their different backgrounds, they struggle to fit into each other's social circles. Xu Yan, with her glamorous hosting career and a "polished" personal history, marries Shen Haoming, who is well aware of and in control of the situation. When conflicts arise, Xu Yan breaks free from Shen Haoming's control and leaves without looking back. Shen Haoming, however, realizes he has fallen deeply in love and is determined to win Xu Yan back. Through various trials, the two eventually shed their pretenses, grow closer, gain insights into each other's true selves, and achieve self - realization.

name: I sindet på en forbryder
summary: For years, Kevin Adrian Werner abused children and young people in the hooligan environment and became known as Denmark's biggest serial offender. Former investigator Sebastian Richelsen investigates how it could go so wrong.

name: Crush
summary: Fu Yunyue, the second-in-command of Long City's Chiyan Gang, disregarded her brother Fu Yunzheng's objection and disguised herself to get close to Shen family's young master, Shen Xize. While seeking revenge for her mother by assassinating the family head, Shen Wende, she discovered an even deeper secret.

name: Breslau
summary: The drama is set in Breslau in year 1936. It tells the story of a police commissioner Franz Podolsky, who investigates a brutal murder. Because of the upcoming Olympic Games, the pressure to catch the murderer is immense.

name: Another Soul In Me
summary: An extroverted grandmother and her introverted granddaughter have been lived together for many years but have underlying tensions. After a soul-switching accident, they swap lives. The grandmother tackles the work issues for her granddaughter, while the granddaughter enjoys retirement. Through this journey, they find mutual understanding and healing, discovering the power of love and companionship.

name: Her Disguise
summary: A promising female doctor embarks on a journey of vengeance for her sister, infiltrating a wealthy family to confront the Lu brothers and risking her own future. Living a double life, she uses herself as bait and her heart as a pawn. A tale of strategic love between a cunning female doctor and a scheming young master is about to unfold.

name: Storage Wars: Barry's Best Buys
summary: It wasn't long after the 2010 "Storage Wars" premiere that series star Barry Weiss emerged as a fan favorite. The longtime antiques collector viewed buying the contents of abandoned storage lockers as a hobby, and an auction became the perfect place to display his omnipresent fun-loving, devil-may-care attitude. Whether he wore night vision goggles or employed psychics to help him decipher a locker's worth, Barry was always seeking outlandish ways to gain an edge on the competition. "Best Buys" compiles the most memorable purchases -- and antics -- of the treasure hunter during his four seasons on the show.

name: American Wreckers
summary: Follow the rivalry between the Belle Boys and the Outsiders, as they battle each week in the demolition derby arena in Belle, Missouri.

name: Uninterrupted's Top Class Tennis
summary: Uninterrupted's Top Class Tennis follows the hard work and sacrifice of four junior tennis players as they make their way to the Orange Bowl, a competition that could make or break their careers as tennis pros.

name: Christine's Garden
summary: Horticulturalist Christine Walkden opens the door on her charming garden.

name: Getting Lost with Erin French
summary: Chef Erin French heads out on a cross-country road trip to find new ingredients and inspiration for another season of cooking at The Lost Kitchen.

name: Catch 21
summary: Based on one of GSN.com's popular online casual games, Catch 21 is a fast-action series blending pop trivia with the tension-filled excitement of the classic card game, 21.

name: Suranne Jones: Investigating Witch Trials
summary: The actor investigates the most infamous witch trials in history and explores their legacy today.

name: Surreal Life: Villa of Secrets
summary: Eight unexpected, hand-selected stars are given a non-transferable golden ticket to a once-in-a-lifetime adventure that money can't buy. In the Surreal Life celebrities will embark on a Surreal Journey that pushes them to leave their personas aside and reveal their true nature in unexpected ways.

name: Construction Fails
summary: Construction Fails happen every day, but sometimes the damage is catastrophic. This factual, fast-paced show investigates the most spectacular mishaps, what went wrong, and how the disaster could have been averted. Combining live footage with CGI animation, this show examines well-known disasters, such as the Notre Dame fire, and the collapse of the Georgia Dome, but also more minor incidents. Presented in a light-hearted and accessible manner, Construction Fails shows what happens when things go drastically wrong.

name: Resurrected Rides
summary: A charming host works with skilled car experts to transform beat-up vehicles into outlandish rides that exceed their unsuspecting owners' wildest dreams.

name: Tomorrow's Pioneers
summary: Tomorrow's Pioneers (Arabic: رواد الغد Ruwād al-Ghad), also known as The Pioneers of Tomorrow, is a Palestinian children's television show that was broadcast by the Hamas-affiliated television station Al-Aqsa TV from April 13, 2007 to October 16, 2009, and featured young host Saraa Barhoum and her co-host Farfour, a large Mickey Mouse-like costumed character, performing skits (or "scenes") and discussing life in Palestine in a talk show fashion with call-ins from children (typically of age 9–13 with some as young as 3).

name: Battle of the Writers
summary: Writer Aob-On faces accusations of plagiarism from top online novelist Shan and his attempts to clear his name are thwarted when evidence vanishes and Shan refuses to engage. This deepens Aob-On's resentment towards Shan. However, they unexpectedly collaborate on a project.

name: My Glastonbury
summary: iPlayer and BBC TV bring you exclusive coverage of the world's most famous music festival.

name: Match Game
summary: Contestants try to match celebrity answers.

name: Щасливі за сім днів
summary: Do not miss the project of radical transformations - watch online Happy in seven days on the STB YouTube channel! In just one week, the heroes of the program will be able to face their fear, believe in their own strength and become happier. And professional experts of the program, Maryna Borzhemska, Nadiya Matveeva and Andriy Zhelvitro, will help them in this.

name: Yttersia
summary: Norwegian documentary series about life on Sommarøy and Brensholmen.

name: Happy Tree Friends: Ka-Pow!
summary: Happy Tree Friends that focus on ACTION and ADVENTURE!

name: Badanamu Cadets
summary: Follow Bada and his fellow cadets as they battle against the forces of darkness and keep the world of Badanamu safe. New antagonists devoted to mischief and destruction emerge from the dark forests beyond Wonderwood, and it will take all the cadets' bravery and careful thinking to stop them.

name: Badanamu Song
summary: Badanamu started with an idea to change the world of early learning. Young children can learn and engage with ESL, phonics, and STEM lessons through our educational songs and nursery rhymes. We create high-quality, educational songs for you and your kids to enjoy together.

name: Badanamu
summary: Badanamu started with an idea to change the world of early learning. Young children can learn and engage with ESL, phonics, and STEM lessons through our educational songs and nursery rhymes. We create high-quality, educational songs for you and your kids to enjoy together.

name: Limited 72 Hours of Love
summary: Su Nuannuan, a 25-year-old blind box designer, has a terrible birthday filled with overtime, misunderstandings, and a breakup. She wishes for a perfect boyfriend on her birthday. In her despair, she buys a seemingly ordinary blind box from a corner store. From then on, she embarks on a fantastical journey with a blind box boyfriend. Will her hope for true love come true?

name: Три богатыря. Ни дня без подвига
summary: The heroes will accomplish many feats: they will revive the unfortunate Koshchey, find the missing crown of the Prince, deal with the cruel khan - they can do everything. They can even cope with evil spirits. The horse Julius, the Serpent Gorynych and many others are always ready to come to the aid of the three heroes.

name: Unveil: Jadewind
summary: On the Lantern Festival's luminous night, Princess Ningyuan died weirdly at the royal banquet. Assigned to this enigma were Li Peiyi from the Inner Surveillance Bureau and Xiao Huaijin, the director of the Imperial Astrology Bureau. Li Peiyi, unmatched in combat and perspicacious in life, aloof but soft-hearted, devoted herself to revealing the truth. To her, each case is more like a match against darkness itself. In the tacit cooperation with the meticulous Xiao Huaijin, they drew out the threads of the cocoon and ultimately dug out the truth and the real culprits through the domineering daughter of a powerful nobleman and the secretive General Lin of the Jinwu Guards. What came later was a storm of bizarre in-palace mystery cases: "Blossoms on Stone", "Crimson Prodigy", "Hour of Ill Omens", and "Seven Stars Unbound", which involved the fate of various females in the palace. During the investigations, they explored the wonders of the Tang Dynasty and witnessed the touching emotions of the world. Gradually, they found out the truth behind the extermination of the Li family fifteen years ago, and ultimately revealed the conspiracy of the masterminds behind the scenes. In these contests, Li Peiyi not only cleared her father's name, but also gained a trustworthy companion and redemption!

name: This Week in Google
summary: Get a big-picture view and detailed analysis of technology topics with This Week in Google. A diverse and opinionated panel dissects Big Tech's products and services, corporate leadership and competition, policies and internal workings, emerging tech, global impacts, and what they all mean to individuals and communities. Google's reach extends well into every facet of our connected world, and everything technology touches is open for discussion. Join hosts Leo Laporte, Jeff Jarvis, and Paris Martineau to hear thought-provoking conversations.

previousepisode.name: You Got Something Jammed in There Good

name: My Son Jeffrey: The Dahmer Family Tapes
summary: Through never-before-heard family tape recordings, this 4-part true crime series offers a brand new insight into Jeffrey Dahmer, one of the world's most infamous serial killers and his victims.

name: Judged by Matt Walsh
summary: All rise for the Honorable Judge Walsh, court is now in session. Watch Matt Walsh bring his iconic deadpan delivery of common sense solutions to real life litigants with actual petty grievances. Find humor in the judiciary process in this fresh take on the reality courtroom genre.

name: Everybody Still Hates Chris
summary: Everybody Still Hates Chris will feature Chris Rock as "Adult Chris," narrating stories inspired by his experience growing up as a skinny nerd in a large working-class family in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn, during the late 1980s.

name: CNN Newsroom with Jim Acosta
summary: Veteran journalist Jim Acosta presents in-depth analysis and weekend coverage of the day's top news stories from around the world.

name: Высшая мера
summary: Yaroslavl, 1974. Two high-profile cases are taking place in the city: first, a recidivist thief Lukin, nicknamed Burelom, is killed with an awl in the ear, and then a mentally ill physicist Kalenov cuts off the head of a neighbor and brings it to the police. Egor Tabolin, an investigator for particularly important cases, is taking over the investigation of the case. He is convinced that twice Hero of the Soviet Union pilot Timofey Kretov, who previously confessed to the murder of Lukin, is innocent, and the woman was obviously killed for a reason. Tabolin realizes that both crimes are connected by an invisible thread that leads to a local psychiatric hospital run by the head physician Mikhail Nagornykh and his deputy Viktor Vaganov. Now the main task of the investigator is not only to sort out these complicated cases and understand what the hospital management has to do with the crimes, but also to catch the elusive killer and achieve capital punishment for the perpetrators.

name: Who Can Forget?
summary: Peeks into the past's news stories from pivotal years.

name: The Unexpected
summary: Anthology series of crime and horror stories similar to Alfred Hitchcock Presents.

previousepisode.name: Some Day They'll Give Us Guns

name: Kerma
summary:
Kerma tells the story of Riku – a young man who seeks revenge by infiltrating a group of the young finnish- elite. He plans to steal from the upper- echelons of society and settle his debt with the local drug-lord. However, to Riku's surprise he finds himself feeling a genuine connection with the rich heiress, Linda and soon he falls hard in love with her despite everything. This leaves Riku at a crossroads; his double life has left him feeling torn between the loyalty for his depressed brother and the newfound love he feels for Linda. But what happens when the mask is ripped off, when the truth is exposed and the lies brought to light?

Are you ready for a series that will keep you on the edge of your seat? Kerma is a suspense-driven series set in a jet-set environment, exploring themes as pride, love and loyalty. Through the eyes of the main character, Riku, we see how people can hide their dark sides behind a false facade, and the brutal contrast between the privileged and the poor. So, if you are looking for a thrilling series, do not miss out on DECEPTION.

name: Narenare -Cheer for You!-
summary: Six high school girls with diverse hobbies, skills, and personalities. Each carrying their own worries, they run, shout, collide, daydream... When the pure desire to support aligns, their cheers resonate in the hearts of those involved. The support of these six high school girls from Gunma might just change the world a little bit?

name: Nöthin' But a Good Time: The Uncensored Story of ‘80s Hair Metal
summary: Nöthin' But A Good Time, a docuseries, showcases the blazing creativity and ambition of the '80s hair metal scene.

name: LALIGA: Más Allá Del Gol
summary: Featuring Griezmann, Lewandowski, Rakitić and Isco, this thrilling docuseries grants exclusive behind-the-scenes access to the 23/24 season of LALIGA.

name: Velodromen Kjendis
summary: In the new reality competition Velodromen Kjendis, eight Norwegian celebrities are put to the test by Dag Otto Lauritzen and Marius Skjelbæk in the Asker cycling velodrome.

name: Vokteren
summary: The goal is to climb the summit of Norway's national mountain, majestic Stetind (1,391 m.a.s.l.) in Narvik municipality in Nordland. On their backs, the participants each have a bag with a sum of money, in which NOK 2.1 million is divided equally between everyone. On their journey through the wilderness, they encounter surprising disputes and intense competitions and challenges, where they must make difficult and bold decisions that will affect both themselves and the group.

name: Jimmy and Shivi's Farmhouse Breakfast
summary:
Join Jimmy Doherty and Shivi Ramoutar at Jimmy's Suffolk farm for the show weekends were made for! A series full of delicious food and drink, craft, animals and country life…there really is something for everyone. 

Each week Jimmy and Shivi will whip up a tasty meal or two on their outdoor kitchen and suggest some drinks to go with them. They'll try their hand at arts and crafts, from making terrariums to upcycling wooden pallets, and they'll be chatting to a different celeb face in every show, getting the lowdown on the worlds of entertainment and sports. As if that weren't enough, Jimmy will give viewers a unique behind the scenes glimpse into the lives of the animals at his wildlife park, and Shivi explores the local area meeting great characters with stories to tell and skills to share.

Jimmy & Shivi's Farmhouse Breakfast really is everything you need for a fun-packed weekend!

name: The Chris McCausland Show
summary: The Chris McCausland Show will feature a brilliant line-up of celebrity guests and will be packed with humour, insights and inevitable shenanigans. Chris will immerse his guests in his audio world with interactive games that will have viewers of all ages laughing and playing along at home. And to top it all off, he'll have live acoustic performances that will be the soundtrack of your weekend.

name: Fear Files: Darr Ki Sacchi Tasveerein
summary: The series mainly focuses on the story of different paranormal and strange cases from different parts of India inspired from real life incidents. It also shows investigation and subsequent exorcism.

name: As Canções da Minha Vida
summary: As Canções da Minha Vida is a great mosaic of Brazilian music. Through interviews and musical performances we learn the most striking songs that influenced the Brazilian songbook. A great homage to the Brazilian music made by its protagonists.

name: The Tyrant
summary: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the U.S. The U.S. demands the termination of the project, but a delivery accident occurs during the NIS's attempt to hand over the sample. Paul, a U.S. Agent, harshly pressures the NIS after the incident and confronts the leader of the project, Director Choe. Meanwhile, Jagyeong, a key character in this case, and Lim Sang, a retired veteran, begin chasing Director Choe's subordinate, Moyong, for different reasons. Everyone gathers in the end, and an unexpected turn of events takes place as ownership of the last sample is at stake.

name: PowerPoint with Jack Graham
summary: Dr. Jack Graham's mission is to glorify God by introducing Jesus Christ as Lord to as many people as possible and to develop them in Christian living using the most effective means to impact the world, making an eternal difference in this generation.

name: Influential with Katty Kay
summary: The BBC's Katty Kay sits down for in-depth conversations with some of the most powerful and change making people in the worlds of culture, business and science. From world renowned chefs and dancers, to the people redefining the way we think about medicine, business strategy and literature, Katty's informal, unscripted interviews reveal the people behind the personas that are inspiring the world today.

name: Vote 2024: The Leaders
summary: Political leaders are quizzed by Christopher Hope with analysis from Patrick Christys and political guests.

name: Britain Decides with The Rest Is Politics and Gogglebox
summary: As the polls close, Krishnan Guru-Murthy and Emily Maitlis presents news and analysis as the votes are counted, while ex-Labour strategist Alastair Campbell and former Conservative MP Rory Stewart steer viewers through what many are predicting to be a game-changing moment in British politics. Cathy Newman anchors from locations across London and reporters attend key counts across the country, while political editor Gary Gibbon offers continuous analysis. Mathematics professor Hannah Fry crunches the data at the big screen, helping to make sense of the numbers and tell the story of the night. Going beyond Westminster, Gogglebox favourites provide their take on the election campaigns, while an audience of voters give their take as the night unfolds.

name: Mafia Spies
summary: In Mafia Spies viewers discover real-world spies, gangsters, honeypots and mistresses that unravels a hidden conspiracy between the CIA and the Chicago mob to assassinate Fidel Castro at a critical time in the Cold War; President Kennedy made it known that there was no living with Castro with missiles 90 miles from American soil.

name: Sniper Butterfly
summary: A confident, independent woman, meets a straightforward, loyal yet untamed younger man. Their journey of mutual healing and redemption unfolds into a love story that is both irresistibly sweet and deeply intense, filled with a captivating sense of destiny.

name: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes
summary: Outrageous Love with NeNe Leakes captures the trials, triumphs, and tribulations of real couples. The new series showcases wild clips of real people caught up in love as NeNe reacts and gives her personal insight alongside the action.

name: Parents Gone Wild
summary: Parents Gone Wild depicts parenthood in all its messy glory - it can be exhausting, rewarding, exasperating, and laugh-out-loud funny. These raw, real, and relatable moments are captured by the moms, dads and even kids in their own personal videos, providing an intimate glimpse into the world of parenting like never before.

name: Monday's Experts
summary: Hosted by Tony Armstrong with Catherine Murphy, Monday's Experts is a new sports entertainment show covering all that happens both on and off the field each week, joined by a panel of sports journalists and comedians.

name: Megafauna: What Killed Australia's Giants?
summary: Australia was once home to a group of extraordinary animals known as Megafauna. What became of them has been debated for over a century, but now a team of scientists are re-opening this paleolithic cold case.

name: Beggar My Neighbour
summary: Rose and Lana are sisters, both married and living next door to each other in Lankworthy Road, Muswell Hill - a London suburb. Gerald Garvey is an underpaid, middle-class executive who has a snobbish attitude, but he and Rose don't have the income to back it up. Harry Butt, on the other hand, is an affluent, working-class fitter, and he and Lana never miss the chance to show off their luxury goods and lifestyle in front of their poorer relatives.

name: Streetwise
summary: Children's drama series about a London-based cycle courier company.

name: 60 кг
summary: A senior high school student dreams of becoming a Greco-Roman wrestling champion, but his strict father forces him to give up the sport for a career as a doctor. The main character faces a choice: to fulfill his dream or his father's dream.

name: BMX All Stars
summary:
Narrated by Ashley Walters, BMX All Stars follows young riders from one of the most successful clubs in the UK, Peckham BMX.

The ten-episode series, packed full with adrenaline-fuelled, BMX racing, also features Olympians Kye Whyte, Beth Shriever, Quillan Isidore and freestyler Charlotte Worthington, as well as pro rider Tian Isidore and freestyler James Jones.

name: Business Drive
summary: Join Kris Smith as he explores the diverse world of Australian tradesmen, highlighting the crucial roles they play in construction, plumbing, farming, carpentry, and more.

name: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy
summary: The Maine Cabin Masters have set out to test their skills in a whole new country -- Italy! Chase, Sarah and the kids head to a remote village to renovate their own dream home and along the way, they get a little help from their friends!

name: El extraño retorno de Diana Salazar
summary: With a plot elaborated over time, this story about the forbidden love of Leonor and Eduardo in the 17th century had a tragic ending as she was sentenced to death for witchcraft. However, the mysterious fate brought them together several centuries later as Diana and Mario. This time, she is a doctor and he is a renowned scientist. Will they succumb to an inexplicable attraction and open their arms to eternal love 400 years later?

name: Sky News Today
summary: Jayne Secker presents the latest breaking news, reports and analysis from the Sky News team across the UK and around the world.

name: Dropout Presents
summary: A new series of live recorded comedy specials, including stand-up, improv, and solo performances!

name: Queerpiphany
summary: Munroe Bergdorf and Tayce meet up with British LGBTQ+ celebrities to discuss the pop culture moments that influenced their queer identities, their "queerpiphanies". Guests also plan a fictional party in honour of these moment.

name: Hostage
summary:
Abigail Dalton the recently elected British Prime Minister is fighting for office thanks to a healthcare crisis. Vivienne Toussaint is the first female French President campaigning for re-election no matter what — including tackling France's borders.

A summit between the two women could be the answer to their prayers if they can agree. But when Dalton's husband is kidnapped and Toussaint is blackmailed, they both face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry where their political futures, and lives, might hang in the balance, can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them both?

name: Secret Nazi Science
summary: When the war ends in 1945, the Allies and Soviets sweep across former Nazi territory, freeing Europe from the evil clutches of the Axis. And as the threat of the Nazis recedes, it leaves behind strange artefacts of a dark science geared towards world domination, morbid experiments in biology and genetic engineering, weapons to unleash chaos, world firsts and bests, all geared towards fomenting Nazi supremacy. How was science being mobilized for dark purposes? What secret Nazi science remains to be uncovered?

name: Love's Little Delicacies
summary: The Food Blogger's Journey: Exploring Shaanxi Flavors The food blogger, Shi Guang, along with the manager Ji Yu, embarked on a culinary adventure through Shaanxi on a variety show. Through discovering local delicacies, they uncovered heartwarming stories that revealed new perspectives on life and personal growth.

name: Pulling with My Parents
summary: Pulling with My Parents follows young singletons from across the country who are stuck in a merry-go-round of bad dates and dating apps. Jaded with swiping left or right, ghosting and disastrous dates, these singletons are taking drastic action and handing over the reins to their parents to give their dating profiles a full make-over to crack the cupid conundrum.

name: Sky News at One
summary: Jayne Secker presents a comprehensive round-up of all the key stories of the day so far, with all the latest breaking news, live events and reports and analysis from Sky News correspondents around the world.

name: Roots of Comedy with Jesus Trejo
summary: Part comedy, part social commentary, host Jesus Trejo embarks on a journey across America meeting with six rising comedians who explore the mosaic of our nation through the lens of stand-up comedy.

name: The Lake
summary: For young adults, summer is a time of reinvention, romance, rivalries and friendships. Families come to Lake Eleanor to escape their daily lives back home; but will they only find more drama?

name: Madison
summary: Madison is about a group of teenagers in high school. The show deals with their everyday problems and concerns. We see the kids grow from high school students to fully grown adults.

name: Sibs
summary: Nora, Audie, and Lily are three sisters navigating life events. Lily is newly single, Audie worried about her real estate career while Nora is a successful accountant happily married to Howie.

name: Cris Miró (Ella)
summary: The story of Cris Miró, the first successful Argentine trans star, an icon of the 90s and a revolutionary whose legacy still lives on.

name: How Dare You!?
summary: Yu Wanyin transmigrated into a novel about palace fighting. The female protagonist of the novel was also transmigrated into the novel. In order to reverse her fate as a villain, Yu Wanyin chose to join forces with a tyrant. Unexpectedly, the tyrant was also a transmigrant into the novel. Yu Wanyin hopes that the three modern people can put aside their palace fights and sit together to fight landlords and eat hot pot. However, the female protagonist believes that she is the chosen one, and still chooses to stand against the male protagonist Duan Wang's team. Yu Wanyin has to carry out a series of actions in order to survive and help Daxia avoid the drought crisis...

name: 1989: The Year That Made Us
summary: A chronicle of the most consequential events of 1989.

name: Geheimnisse der Meere
summary: Teeming with marine wildlife, our oceans are full of fascinating stories – like that of the sperm whale, the biggest predator on earth, that lives in the Mediterranean alongside the elusive monk seal. Underwater filmmaker Thomas Behrend takes us to the habitat of the ocean sunfish with the help of a high-tech submarine camera. And while giant octopuses and manatees are the heroes of another story, a marine biologist tells us about her unique friendship with a dolphin on the Irish coast.

name: The Old Dog, New Tricks?
summary: Ryotaro is a cheerful professional soccer player devoted to the game he loves. He has risen to national team member, and come through with decisive goals when it counts… until injury begins to plague him. Facing retirement at 37, he realizes it is a little late for him to enter normal working society. Enter a sports management company called "Victory" which offers him a new lease on life. Yet somewhere in his heart, Ryotaro has not quite accepted his retirement, and he will need to reconcile with new challenges as an old rookie.
